title: Figure 5: schematic design of a magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) generator
description: 3D schematic of a blue rectangular channel with a yellow electrode plate on top and grey permanent magnets on either side, with callouts for the "Direction of the Magnetic Field, B," "Path of Ions Between the Magnets," electrodes carrying current away, and magnets or solenoids generating the field. Captioned "Figure 5. Schematic Design of a Magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) Generator." It opens Chapter 2, "Nuclear Fusion Rocket Design," alongside the D-T fusion equation and Lorentz force equation.
